svg.aria-label: puppeteer: many agents, one runtime, their own terminals
svg.title: puppeteer: many agents, one runtime, their own terminals
svg.desc: A small plate above a wide floor. On the floor lie terminal panes, each showing a different agent's own interface, and a dotted pane at the front for the next agent. A string runs from every pane up to the plate, the one runtime you call. Halfway, the strings cross a dotted plane: the native signals, hooks, protocols and logs. Each string is tied to a pane at its edge, never its screen: state comes from signals, never from the screen.
